mentions.name: SignMyPDF
mentions.description: This app makes hosting temporary PDF forms simple without needing an account or payment. Users add input fields over any static PDF and publish it to get a shareable link that others can use to fill the form. Forms stay online for 30 days, with paid plans planned to keep them online longer.
mentions.problem: Hosting temporary fillable PDF forms typically requires an account and payment.
mentions.audience: other people who may need to fill the form
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an app[0] that makes hosting temporary PDF forms simple, without needing an account or payment. You simply add input fields over any static PDF and publish it to get a link which you can send to other people who may need to fill the form.
